description.text:

Crystal Mode: Machinist Ability Boost, Dualcast Machinist, Zero Hone Cost to Machinist Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: 6 single-target Lightning/NE ranged physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast, [Cap Break Level 1, Machinist Damage +30% & 50% DEF/RES Pierce] for 2 turns & Quick ATB 1 to user
